metadata.question: Was soil moisture higher at the Coastal Sage UCI station in California during January 2013 than during May 2013?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Was soil moisture higher at the Coastal Sage UCI station in California during January 2013 than during May 2013?" We need to: 1. Choose a soil moisture dataset available in GEE for 2013. Options: - SMAP: starts 2015 (too late) - ESA CCI Soil Moisture (ECMWF/ESA/CCI_DAILY_SOIL_MOISTURE_V03_DAILY): daily data from 1978-2016, band 'sm' (volumetric soil moisture m³/m³) - GLDAS: but might be coarse - Use ESA CCI as it's appropriate for 2013. 2. Location: Coastal Sage UCI station. Without exact coordinates, we assume a point in UCI Ecological Preserve: (33.642, -117.843). We'll use a small buffer (100 m) to ensure pixel coverage. 3. Time periods: - January 2013: 2013-01-01 to 2013-01-31 - May 2013: 2013-05-01 to 2013-05-31 4. Processing: - Filter collection by date and bounds. - Check collection size: if 0, output C1. - Mask invalid values: ESA CCI has valid range 0-1 m³/m³. We'll mask values outside [0,1]. - Compute mean soil moisture over each month (mean of daily images). - Reduce at the point with scale=1000 to get mean value. - Check pixel count: use reducer.count() on the mean image? Actually for a point, count will be 1. But we can check if the value is null (masked in all images). - Validate result: not null, not NaN, within valid range. - Compare: if Jan mean > May mean → A (Yes), else B (No). 5. Potential issues: - No data in collection: C1. - All pixels masked (value null): C2? But for a point, if the value is null, it means no valid pixels in any image at that point. We can check by seeing if the mean is null. - Invalid calculation (NaN, etc.): C3. We'll output: - Number of images for each month. - Mean soil moisture values. - Then the answer tag. Implementation steps: 1. Define geometry (point with buffer). 2. Define date ranges. 3. Load ESA CCI collection, filter by date and bounds. 4. Check size: if 0, try alternative? There's no direct alternative for 2013 soil moisture. If no data, output C1. 5. Mask invalid values (sm < 0 or sm > 1). 6. Compute mean image for the month. 7. Reduce region to get mean and count at the point. 8. Check count: if 0, output C2. 9. Check if value is valid (not null, finite). 10. Compare and output answer. We'll structure code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Coastal Sage UCI station (approximate) const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.843, 33.642]); // Longitude, Latitude const geom = point.buffer(100); // Small buffer to ensure pixel coverage // 2. Define date ranges const janStart = '2013-01-01'; const janEnd = '2013-01-31'; const mayStart = '2013-05-01'; const mayEnd = '2013-05-31'; // 3. Load ESA CCI Soil Moisture dataset const dataset = 'ECMWF/ESA/CCI_DAILY_SOIL_MOISTURE_V03_DAILY'; const band = 'sm'; // volumetric soil moisture in m3/m3 // Function to mask invalid values (outside 0-1) function maskInvalid(image) { const sm = image.select(band); const valid = sm.gte(0).and(sm.lte(1)); // valid range return image.updateMask(valid); } // Function to process a month function processMonth(startDate, endDate) { const col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geom) .map(maskInvalid); const size = col.size(); const meanImg = col.mean().select(band); // Reduce region to get mean and count const stats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return {col: col, size: size, stats: stats, meanImg: meanImg}; } // Process January 2013 const janResult = processMonth(janStart, janEnd); const janSize = janResult.size.getInfo(); const janStats = janResult.stats.getInfo(); const janMean = janStats[band]; const janCount = janStats[band + '_count']; // Process May 2013 const mayResult = processMonth(mayStart, mayEnd); const maySize = mayResult.size.getInfo(); const mayStats = mayResult.stats.getInfo(); const mayMean = mayStats[band]; const mayCount = mayStats[band + '_count']; // 4. Check for missing data (C1) if (janSize === 0 || maySize === 0) { console.log(`January 2013 Images: ${janSize}`); console.log(`May 2013 Images: ${maySize}`); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (janCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { console.log(`January 2013 Valid Pixels: ${janCount}`); console.log(`May 2013 Valid Pixels: ${mayCount}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Validate results (C3) if (janMean === null || mayMean === null || isNaN(janMean) || isNaN(mayMean) || !isFinite(janMean) || !isFinite(mayMean)) { console.log(`January 2013 Mean: ${janMean}`); console.log(`May 2013 Mean: ${mayMean}`); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Output intermediate stats and final answer console.log(`January 2013: Images: ${janSize}, Mean SM: ${janMean.toFixed(4)}, Valid Pixels: ${janCount}`); console.log(`May 2013: Images: ${maySize}, Mean SM: ${mayMean.toFixed(4)}, Valid Pixels: ${mayCount}`); // Compare if (janMean > mayMean) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
